On the Premium user retrieval benchmark, **Holistic-171 gets an ACC of 0.794 and a MAR@25 of 0.169** (Table 1, page 7).

- **ACC** checks whether the clicked candidate gets the highest score among four candidates: one positive and three negatives. Random guessing scores 0.25 (page 7).
- **MAR@25** measures how often clicked candidates rank in the top 25 of a fixed pool of 100 candidates. All models use the same pool (page 7).

**Comparison with PAIR** (Table 1, page 7):

| Model | ACC | MAR@25 |
|---|---|---|
| Holistic-171 | 0.794 | 0.169 |
| Off-the-shelf 0.6B embedding | 0.771 | 0.100 |
| PAIR with P-ATT history | 0.967 | 0.265 |

The authors note that ACC is close to saturation because it uses only four candidates. They therefore treat MAR@k as the more informative metric (page 7).
